name: Chert
description: Nodular chert: hard blunt lumps set in a softer bed, each one faceted where it broke.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: @pick(4%, 16%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(67.1% 3.0%, 97.4% 34.1%, 92.0% 77.1%, 55.0% 99.8%, 14.2% 84.9%, 0.4% 43.8%, 23.9% 7.3%); clip-path: polygon(67.1% 3.0%, 97.4% 34.1%, 92.0% 77.1%, 55.0% 99.8%, 14.2% 84.9%, 0.4% 43.8%, 23.9% 7.3%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
